verdict.rationale: Claude Code has first-class MCP support documented with clear examples: connecting to hundreds of external tools/data sources via MCP, CLI commands to add MCP servers (e.g., 'claude mcp add --transport http notion'), integrating Google Drive, Jira, Slack, PostgreSQL, and even MCP servers acting as event channels pushing messages into sessions. This is a core, well-documented agentic capability, not a peripheral feature.
